set.body:
Outcome
Review the native result before catalog expansion; review must be distinguishable from builder self-checks.

Owned scope
docs/evidence/vertical-slice; native captures and review findings

Prerequisites
B2

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A reviewer other than the slice implementer inspects exact candidate captures and reruns key consumer interactions; record reviewer identity and candidate SHA.
- [ ] Accept light/dark × comfortable/compact at 1280×800 and 1024×700, plus 800×600 recovery; check native font baseline, text floors, selected/focused/inactive distinction, and detached inspector.
- [ ] Change density after a drag is armed and verify safe cancellation, subsequent header/edge targets, resize hit area and pane identity. Open menus/dialogs during appearance changes.
- [ ] Every blocking finding has a reproduction and is repaired/rechecked or remains open; do not pass based on browser similarity alone.
- [ ] The accepted native specimens become versioned baselines; preserve the browser references as original design intent.

Required evidence
SHA-bound independent review, four variant baseline manifest, interaction logs and closed blocking findings.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code B3. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [B3] Independently accept the native docked vertical slice
